title_text: THE GIRL WITH THE BLURRED FACE
credits_text: A SHORT FILM BY PABLO PAGAN
other_text: ENTROPY PRODUCTIONS presents a film by PABLO PAGAN in association with SOUTHLINK. MUSIC BY NASEE LAZAR and L'ORQUE. CAST: BONNIE RIVERA, EMILY HERNANDEZ, CARLOS RAMIREZ, GABRIEL PEREZ, ALEJANDRO ESPINO. EXECUTIVE PRODUCER: CESAR LAZAR. PRODUCER: PABLO PAGAN. DIRECTOR OF PHOTOGRAPHY: CESAR LAZAR. EDITOR: PABLO PAGAN. SOUND DESIGN: ALEJANDRO ESPINO. RELEASED: 2023.
description: A poster features a blurred, ghostly silhouette of a person against a dark background with bold white text reading "The Girl with the Blurred Face."
